body.name: Compact buffered known-J recovery class
body.construction:
\[
 \mathcal P_\kappa=\left\{P\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{face}}:
 \min_k\mathfrak m_k(p)\geq2\kappa,\quad
 \min_{\ell\in\mathcal L}\Sigma_{\ell\ell}(p)\geq2\kappa\right\},
\]
with closure taken inside the finite-parameter compatible image on the \(N_m\)-cell absorption-legal support.
